name: Can accessibility modifications be integrated into rental turnover or pre-sale repairs?

mainEntity.name: Can accessibility modifications be integrated into rental turnover or pre-sale repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, adapting a home for accessible living before renting or selling expands your potential market to seniors and individuals with mobility requirements. Modifications like widening interior doorways, installing supportive framing behind bathroom walls for secure grab bars, eliminating raised thresholds between rooms, and swapping difficult knobs for lever handles are common. HH Remodeling handles accessibility updates alongside standard turnover carpentry and drywall work, ensuring modifications blend naturally into the home’s interior design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, adjustments such as widened doorways, zero-barrier transitions, lever hardware, and reinforced grab bar backing can be completed alongside regular cosmetic repairs.
